title: Two Men at Muscogee Bridge, 1960s Florida B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Oze & Carl
at the Bridge
In muscogee Fla
description: A square vintage snapshot capturing two casually dressed men identified as Oze and Carl standing together in front of a newly constructed concrete highway bridge in Muscogee, Florida. In the background beneath the overpass, two mid-century automobiles are parked beside the supports, set against the backdrop of Florida pine woods under bright natural sunlight.
